review_comment_single_form.name: review_comment_single_form
review_comment_single_form.value: NOT ("homework_submissions"."review_comment_text" IS NOT NULL AND "homework_submissions"."review_comment_voice_file_id" IS NOT NULL)

reviewed_fields_consistent.name: reviewed_fields_consistent
reviewed_fields_consistent.value:
("homework_submissions"."status" = 'pending' AND "homework_submissions"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "homework_submissions"."reviewed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("homework_submissions"."status" IN ('passed','needs_resubmission') AND "homework_submissions"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "homework_submissions"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)

material_fields_consistent.name: material_fields_consistent
material_fields_consistent.value:
("lesson_materials"."material_type" = 'text' AND "lesson_materials"."text_content" IS NOT NULL AND "lesson_materials"."telegram_file_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("lesson_materials"."material_type" IN ('video','file') AND "lesson_materials"."telegram_file_id" IS NOT NULL AND "lesson_materials"."text_content" IS NULL)

lesson_type_fields_consistent.name: lesson_type_fields_consistent
lesson_type_fields_consistent.value:
("lessons"."lesson_type" = 'live' AND "lessons"."recorded_video_file_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("lessons"."lesson_type" = 'recorded' AND "lessons"."live_call_link" IS NULL AND "lessons"."live_recording_file_id" IS NULL)

exactly_one_recipient.name: exactly_one_recipient
exactly_one_recipient.value:
("notifications_log"."recipient_type" = 'student' AND "notifications_log"."recipient_student_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications_log"."recipient_staff_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("notifications_log"."recipient_type" = 'staff' AND "notifications_log"."recipient_staff_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications_log"."recipient_student_id" IS NULL)

staff_auth_method_matches_role.name: staff_auth_method_matches_role
staff_auth_method_matches_role.value:
("staff_users"."role" = 'owner' AND "staff_users"."telegram_id" IS NOT NULL AND "staff_users"."username" IS NULL AND "staff_users"."password_hash" IS NULL)
        OR ("staff_users"."role" IN ('teacher', 'assistant') AND "staff_users"."telegram_id" IS NULL AND "staff_users"."username" IS NOT NULL AND "staff_users"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL)
